Evaluate wine like a professional. You will be using a 100-point scale that is widely used in international competitions and prestigious publications. Not sure where to start? Don’t give up, it isn’t at all difficult. Use a simple marking system, from 1 to 5.

Individual characteristics of a wine are evaluated separately. First you give a mark to appearance, then aroma, and finally taste. Each of these characteristics is further broken down into:

Appearance
* clarity
* colour (to what degree colour corresponds to the varietal, year, type of wine, etc.)
Aroma (“nose”)
* intensity
* purity (to what degree aroma corresponds to the varietal, year, type of wine, etc.)
* harmony
Taste
* intensity
* purity (to what degree taste corresponds to the varietal, year, type of wine, etc.)
* harmony
* persistence (how long the taste impression lasts)

Finally you evaluate overall impression. With this you express how the much the wine is to your taste, and how the individual characteristics go together.

Give every quality a mark on a 5-point scale, where 1 is best and 5 is worst:

1 excellent 
2 very good 
3 good 
4 satisfactory 
5 not satisfactory 

The mark then is given points, which can vary depending on the relative importance of the characteristic concerned. The points awarded can be displayed in the application at the press of a button.

The resulting score is in the range of 40-100 points:

40 - 69 undrinkable wine
70 - 74 mediocre wine
76 - 79 a wine that makes no particular impression
80 - 84 a good everyday drinking wine without serious flaws
85 - 89 very good wine
90 - 94 excellent wine, worth tasting
95 - 100 wine of the absolute highest quality, unique and fantastic

        When you want to evaluate the next wine, you can clear the assigned points either by pushing the button with a wastepaper basket

Over 500 easy & healthy plant-based recipes, meal planner, pre-made meal plans, recipe videos, shopping list and more. All recipes are whole food plant-based recipes by Alexandra Andersson (@fivesechealth).

Do you want to eat more plants in your everyday life? Every week we add new recipes to keep you inspired. All recipes are 100% vegan and beginner friendly with common ingredients. We believe vegan cooking should be easy and delicious that’s why we started the Fivesec Health app - the vegan app for everyday cooking. You can see it as a growing cookbook.

Get access to all the content with our 7-day free trial when subscribing monthly!

About the recipes:
All recipes in this app are as whole food plant based as possible with minimal processed foods, but still super tasty. You will find lots of dinner ideas, breakfast ideas, lunches, snacks, treats, festive and side dishes. If you have allergies you can easily filter for gluten-free, nut-free, oil-free and soy-free to find recipes that fit your preferences. We have also included filters on high protein, under 25 min, low calories and few ingredients.

Fivesec Health features:
• Meal Plans – Do you want extra guidance? We have developed meal plans based on different goals. You don’t have to think, just follow the instructions. Sounds awesome right? If you are new to vegan cooking, this is the perfect way to start
• Shopping List – Our focus is to make it as easy as possible to eat more plants. Therefore we have developed a super handy shopping list that makes it possible to add ingredients from an entire recipe. All the ingredients from the recipes are structured in a way so that you easily can sort them by sections in the grocery store. You can also add your own items.
• Meal planner – Plan your week ahead of time with our meal planner feature.
• Plant-Based Nutrition - We want you to feel confident in your food choices therefore we have provided a learn section where you can read about all the essential nutrients and in which foods you can find them. All information is evidenced based and provided by a nutritionist.
• Macros & calories – All recipes are carefully composed and you can see the micronutrients in a recipe and the calories based per serving.
• Cooking time – See how long time each recipe takes too cook.
• Add a note – You can now write a note on a specific recipe to remember things. 
• Favorites – Save your favorite recipes so that you can cook them over and over again.
• Measurement system – You can choose to see ingredients in cup/g or ml/g.
• Hide nutrition information – We want this app to be safe for everyone. By hiding nutritional information you can’t see macros, calories or search for low calories. We highly recommend you to do that if you have/had an eating disorder.
